metadata.intent:
Build a reusable feature-development workflow for this repository. Accept a
feature request, acceptance expectations, a branch name, and the repository
root directory. Inspect the request and repository to identify clean
module-owned implementation packages, propose a plan to the human, and revise
it from their feedback until they explicitly approve it.

Abort unless the checkout is clean, switch to main, pull latest with
fast-forward-only semantics and stop without modifying the worktree on
conflicts, then create the requested branch. Only after the human has
approved the package plan, use Codex or Claude Code to distribute the
approved packages across their owning modules and work on independent
packages concurrently without cross-module pollution. This AGENT_CALL
requires the experimental agent-steps setting to be enabled and an
authenticated Codex or Claude Code account selected; abort with that
requirement if it is not.

Integrate the results, apply the `principal-developer` skill
(`skills/principal-developer/SKILL.md`) as a review gate, then run `cargo fmt
--check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo
test --all-targets --all-features`, and all ignored `live_spec_planning`
tests, fixing findings and repeating relevant checks until clean. Confirm the
diff carries no credentials, personal data, proprietary third-party code, or
license-incompatible generated material. Propose a pull-request title and
body describing the change, why it is needed, how it was tested, and any
follow-up work to the human, and only if they approve, push and create the
pull request with `gh` CLI.

plan.name: repository_feature_development
plan.description: Plan, implement, review, verify, and publish an approved Rust repository feature.

inputs.name: acceptance_expectations
inputs.description: The expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

inputs.name: branch_name
inputs.description: The feature branch to create and publish.

inputs.name: root_directory
inputs.description: The root directory of the repository.

steps.name: Confirm experimental agent requirements
steps.description: Require the experimental agent-steps setting and an authenticated Codex or Claude Code account before any repository changes.

config.prompt: Confirm that the experimental agent-steps setting is enabled and that an authenticated Codex or Claude Code account is selected. Reject this approval to abort if either requirement is missing.

steps.name: Run all Rust targets and features
Clean-update repository and create feature branch
steps.description: Abort on tracked or untracked changes, update main with fast-forward-only semantics, and create the requested branch.

config.inline:
set -euo pipefail
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'The selected directory is not a Git repository.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)" ]; then
  echo 'Checkout is not clean; aborting before changing branches.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git check-ref-format --branch "$BRANCH" >/dev/null
if [ "$BRANCH" = "$BASE_BRANCH" ]; then
  echo 'The feature branch must differ from the base branch.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git switch "$BASE_BRANCH"
git pull --ff-only --no-rebase
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)" ]; then
  echo 'Checkout became dirty while updating the base branch; aborting.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git switch --create "$BRANCH"
printf 'Created clean feature branch %s from updated %s.\n' "$BRANCH" "$BASE_BRANCH"

config.system_prompt: You are a strict source-change compliance reviewer. Determine whether the supplied complete worktree diff contains credentials or secrets, personal data, proprietary third-party code, license-incompatible generated material, or any unreviewable oversized/binary file marker. Return only strict JSON in this shape: {"passed":true,"findings":[]}. Set passed false and provide concise actionable findings whenever prohibited or unreviewable material exists. Do not use Markdown.

steps.name: Inspect workspace ownership
steps.description: Collect deterministic workspace, package, and source-file information for package planning.

steps.name: Propose module-owned package plan
steps.description: Map the request to clean ownership boundaries and concurrency groups.

config.system_prompt: You are a senior Rust repository planner. Produce a concise implementation package plan without writing code. Respect existing module and crate ownership, keep cross-module contracts explicit, and identify only genuinely independent packages as concurrent work. Include affected modules, package boundaries, dependencies, integration order, acceptance mapping, focused regression tests, risks, and review checkpoints.

steps.name: Review initial package plan
steps.description: Collect the first round of human feedback.

steps.name: Repair captured findings
steps.description: Edit only from the current attempt's captured evidence; the next attempt verifies the repair.

config.system_prompt: Revise an implementation package plan using human feedback. Preserve the plan unchanged when the feedback is exactly APPROVE. Keep package ownership clean, prevent cross-module pollution, and distinguish concurrent work from ordered integration.

steps.name: Review revised package plan
steps.description: Collect another round of human feedback before final approval.

config.system_prompt: Produce the final complete implementation package plan from the current plan and human feedback. Preserve the current plan unchanged when the feedback is exactly APPROVE. Keep ownership boundaries, concurrency groups, integration order, acceptance mapping, regression coverage, risks, and review gates explicit.

steps.name: Approve final package plan
steps.description: No implementation agent runs until the human explicitly approves.

config.prompt:
Explicitly approve this final package plan to begin implementation, or reject to terminate the run:

${step.revise_package_plan_two.final_package_plan}

steps.name: Implement and integrate approved packages
steps.description: Use the selected coding agent to implement the approved package plan and apply the principal-developer review gate.

config.inline:
set -euo pipefail
CURRENT_BRANCH="$(git branch --show-current)"
if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "$BRANCH" ]; then
  echo 'Current branch no longer matches the requested feature branch.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git add --all
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo 'No feature changes are available to commit.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git commit -m 'feat: implement approved feature'
git rev-parse HEAD

config.system_prompt: Draft a concise pull request. Return only strict JSON with string fields title and body. The body must explain what changed, why it is needed, how it was tested, compliance review status, and any follow-up work. Use Markdown inside the body string, but no Markdown fence around the JSON.

steps.name: Approve pull-request publication
steps.description: Require explicit approval before pushing or creating the pull request.

steps.name: Push branch and create pull request

outputs.name: pull_request_url
outputs.description: The URL of the approved and created pull request.
